import CategoryTheory.Limits.Biproduct
import CategoryTheory.ModuleCategory

open CategoryTheory.Limits

theorem lg_target {R : Type u} [Ring R] : HasFiniteBiproducts (ModuleCat R) := by
  constructor
  intro n
  induction' n with d hd
  case zero =>
    exact { zero_obj := (ModuleCat R).zero }
  case succ d =>
    let X := (ModuleCat R).obj (by infer_instance)
    let Y := (ModuleCat R).obj (by infer_instance)
    let Z := X ⊕ Y
    let i := biprod.inl
    let p := biprod.inr
    let iso₁ := biprod.ι₁_iso
    let iso₂ := biprod.ι₂_iso
    exact { biprod := Z, inl := i, inr := p, ι₁_iso := iso₁, ι₂_iso := iso₂ }
